messages:
marco-support: Hey team, customer acme-prod reporting bulk indexing failures right after the model swap to 'openembed-v2'. Indexer logs show dimension mismatch (expected 1536, got 2048). They also saw a sudden billing spike around the same time. Can we triage?

sophie-oncall: ack. can you paste the exact error lines from the indexer?

marco-support: Sure, from indexer stdout: 
```
ERROR [indexer.2024-11-05T14:32:10Z] insert_batch failed for shard-7: vector_dim_mismatch expected=1536 actual=2048 customer_id=acme-prod batch_id=98765
WARN [indexer] dropping 23 vectors from batch 98765
```
Also embedding service returned 200 but with shape metadata: {"model":"openembed-v2","dim":2048}.

eli-ops: Was there a config change on the indexer or a migration? The DB schema expects 1536.

marco-support: No indexer change; we rolled model for embeddings only at 14:30 by deploy-bot. deploy-bot: `deploy openembed-v2 to embeddings-prod-rs1 @14:29:58`

deploy-bot: Finished rollout to 3/3 zones, health ok.

sophie-oncall: That explains it. Model increased embedding size but indexer/vecdb schema still 1536. Two immediate mitigation options: 1) rollback model to openembed-v1 (1536) or 2) run conversion/backfill to resize vectors in DB (heavy). Recommend rollback + queued backfill.

marco-support: Customer is asking for root cause and ETA. They hit a quota/billing alert because token+embedding units spiked during failed retries. Any quick way to reduce cost impact?

eli-ops: We can throttle retries at the ingestion proxy and mute billing alerts for acme-prod for a short window, but billing team has to sign off. I'll open a billing ticket and mute alerts for 1h.

sophie-oncall: Marco, can you run a quick check to see how many vectors were written successfully vs dropped? `curl` against indexer metrics works.

marco-support: Ran metrics: `indexer_success_count: 1,234,567`, `indexer_dropped_vectors: 23,450` across the 14:30-14:40 window. I also pulled a sample embed from the embeddings API: 
```
$ curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{"model":"openembed-v2","input":["test"]}'
{"data":[{"embedding":[0.0023,...(2048 floats)...] , "meta":{"dim":2048}}]}
```

eli-ops: Ok. Next steps: 1) rollback model (sophie to approve), 2) schedule controlled backfill plan for acme-prod with dim-conversion tool, 3) billing mute & credit discussion, 4) add pre-deploy check to verify indexer expected dim vs model dim.

sophie-oncall: Approving rollback now. marco-support please coordinate rollback and inform customer. Also add a quick postmortem and include ops-runbook changes.

marco-support: Starting rollback now. ETA ~6min. I'll ping customer once completed.

deploy-bot: Rollback triggered: deploy openembed-v1 to embeddings-prod-rs1.

marco-support: Rollback complete at 14:36:12. Indexer errors dropped to baseline within 2m. Customer confirmed ingestion resumed.

eli-ops: Billing ticket created: BILL-1023, requested temporary credit for retry costs and disabled alerts for 60m.

sophie-oncall: Follow-ups: - create a deployment gate: reject model if embedding dim != indexer.dim for customer tenants with fixed vecdb schema - document backfill dim-conversion limits - run a small audit to find other tenants using openembed-v2 and notify them.

marco-support: Noted. I'll file a support follow-up checklist and attach sample log excerpts and curl repro steps.

indexer-bot: automation-note: queued job verify-dim-gate created for next deploys.

marco-support: Thanks all. Customer is satisfied with rollback + credit request. Will update the thread after billing response and after we schedule the backfill.
